supported: The text says a use "should not be deployed" past accepted privacy standards, and, by analogy from the government-services guideline, that an entity "should avoid" models exposing personal data.
unsupported: A binding prohibition. The Ethics document calls its guidelines non-binding.

supported: The text calls for reviewing consent logging and the ability to revoke permission. The guideline names consent as one exception to avoiding exposure, by analogy.
unsupported: A general duty on a telecom operator to obtain consent for this use.
Purpose limitation. The phrase and the concept as a stated duty are absent. Nearest text only: minimum intrusion and need-based access.

template_outcome: Refers the case to an oversight body
supported: The text calls for an oversight mechanism inside the organization and a Data Protection Officer role.
unsupported: Referral to any body outside the organization. The Strategy says a Council oversees implementation of the Strategy; it gives no route for referring a case.
